priorities.summary: SolarWinds patched a critical command injection flaw in Dameware, rated CVSS 9.9 and disclosed on November 3. No exploitation had been confirmed at disclosure; apply the fixed Dameware release promptly.

HPE patched 46 flaws in Fabric Composer, worst CVE-2026-95731 (CVSS 9.8), an unauthenticated hardcoded-password flaw letting an attacker log in and gain administrative access. It affects Fabric Composer 7.4.0 and below and 7.3.4 and below; upgrade to 7.4.1 or 7.3.5.

A use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handling, rated CVSS 9.8, can allow remote unauthenticated code execution via a race during TCP connection setup. Red Hat shipped fixed kernels for RHEL 8, 9 and 10; Ubuntu fixes for older LTS releases were still in testing as of November 3.

model.name: EKA-1
model.summary: The IndiaAI Mission released EKA-1 on November 3, a 26.3-billion-parameter foundation model from Soket Labs trained on about 7.5 trillion tokens. It covers all 22 scheduled Indian languages plus English and is aimed at banking, financial services and cybersecurity work, including math, code, reasoning and agentic tasks.
